title: Account settings
changed: Your password is changed. Your other devices are signed out.
googleOnly: You sign in with Google, so there is no password to change.

stored.account: Your account: e-mail, name, language, and how you sign in (a hashed password or your Google account).
stored.wishes: Your wishes: what you wrote, the preferences you picked, your budget, travellers and dates.
stored.plans: Your plans: the trips built from your wishes, day by day.
stored.quotes: Your quotes: the prices, how long they are valid, and the PDF.
stored.sessions: Your sessions, to keep you signed in: 30 days at most, never your IP address.

storedNever: We never read your mailbox, your documents or your social media.
deleteBody: Your account and everything listed above are erased at once, and you are signed out.
confirmBody: Your account, wishes, plans and quotes will be erased. This cannot be undone.
staffAccount: Agency staff accounts cannot be deleted here: the plans and quotes you handled point to you.
deleteFailed: Your account could not be deleted. Please try again.
